OUR APPROACH TO PERSONALISED CARE

MEET YOUR PHYSIOTHERAPIST

Dr. Vijaya
Gundewar Bojewar

A personal approach. A professional foundation.

A freelance physiotherapist based in Pune, Dr. Vijaya brings over four years of experience and a thoughtful approach to patients with a variety of diagnoses and needs.

Her experience spans musculoskeletal, neurological, cardiopulmonary and community physiotherapy, with over 1.5 years of practice in Pune.

  • Shubh Narayana Physiotherapy Rehab, Nanded

Hands-on experience in musculoskeletal physiotherapy, neurological physiotherapy (including paediatrics), cardiopulmonary physiotherapy and community physiotherapy.
